subject: Request: executive sanction for hosted API accelerator credit
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Wells <ethan.wells@cliniflow.ai>, Contracts <contracts@cliniflow.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pilot pricing and proposal (Cliniflow)

Ethan / Contracts team —

Great to connect earlier. Per our discussion, here's a concise proposal for the 12-month hosted API pilot and initial production rollout:

- Commitment: 12 months committed hosted API usage (monthly invoiced)
- Forecasted consumption: ~200M tokens/month in months 4–12 (see attached forecast)
- Proposed list pricing: standard hosted API rates (token-based)
- Requested concession: 28% accelerator credit off list for the first 12 months (applied as monthly usage credit)
- Rationale: Strategic platform integration, multi-region rollout planned (US + EU), we expect >$1.0M invoice run-rate in year 1 with potential to expand to Dedicated next year.

If this is acceptable we can:
1) Lock the 28% accelerator credit into the SOW and pricing appendix
2) Agree to monthly reporting cadence + token-level usage visibility
3) Execute SOW and initial PO schedule (attached SOW-Draft)

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_Cliniflow_v3.pdf; SOW-Draft-Cliniflow.docx; Cliniflow_Usage_Forecast.xlsx

Ask: Please confirm you want us to lock the 12-month accelerator credit (28%) and the invoice cadence so we can circulate final SOW to legal.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0183

From: Ethan Wells <ethan.wells@cliniflow.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Contracts <contracts@cliniflow.ai>
Date: 2026-08-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pilot pricing and proposal (Cliniflow)

Thanks Marcus — this looks good.

We discussed the volume numbers internally and the 28% accelerator credit is what we need to make internal economics work. Please proceed with locking that into the SOW; Contracts will need an invoice schedule (monthly fine).

Two quick asks:
- Can you add a clause that usage above forecasted thresholds is billed at the same discounted rate for the first quarter after going over?
- We need token-level monthly usage exports for our finance team.

If you can include those, I can push PO routing on our side this week.

—Ethan
Ethan Wells, Head of Product
Cliniflow
ethan.wells@cliniflow.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pilot pricing and proposal (Cliniflow) — need exec signoff for 28%

Ben / Neha — forwarding the prospect confirmation below. Cliniflow will PO quickly if we can lock the 28% accelerator credit and the two small asks. Financials below (high level):

- Year 1 billed usage (conservative): $1.05M
- Gross margin sensitivity at 28% discount: still positive given expected efficiency and prefix caching; assumes no extra SLOs.
- Upside: potential Dedicated conversion in 12–18 months, gives us NRR expansion opportunity.

Why I think exec signoff is warranted:
- Above our standard 20% concession threshold for hosted API — this is a strategic, multi-region customer with likely expansion.
- Short-term revenue and strong reference potential in the healthcare analytics vertical.

Attachments included (forecast + MAP + draft SOW).

Ask: can we escalate to Marissa for executive sanction to approve a 28% accelerator credit (12-month term) and confirm we can accept the two customer asks (billing cadence + usage export)? I recommend approval conditional on Legal signoff of the SOW.

Thanks —
Marcus

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pilot pricing and proposal (Cliniflow) — need exec signoff for 28%

+1 on escalation to Marissa. My read: enterprise strategic account, good expansion motion — support the 28% as a one-time accelerator for 12 months.

Couple of notes:
- Recommend we add a clear overage clause (same discounted rate for the first 30 days after threshold; revert to standard tiers thereafter) — avoids surprise billing.
- Need Finance to confirm monthly invoice cadence aligns with AR policy; I can loop them if you want.

If Marissa signs off, Legal + Finance final review then ship SOW.

—Ben

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Executive sanction request — Cliniflow hosted API 12-month accelerator (28%)

Marissa —

Quick escalation: Cliniflow (prospect -> initial PO) has confirmed they will proceed if we lock a 28% accelerator credit on hosted API usage for a 12-month committed term. Ben & I recommend approval given the strategic expansion potential and expected >$1M year-one revenue.

Key items: 28% accelerator credit (applied monthly), monthly invoicing, token-level monthly exports, short overage protection (same discount for first 30 days after threshold). Attachments: MAP / draft SOW / forecast.

Decision requested: approval to commit to 28% accelerator credit and proceed to Legal for final SOW.

Time sensitivity: customer is routing PO this week — requesting signoff by COB Monday 8/24.

Thanks for taking a look,
Marcus

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive sanction request — Cliniflow hosted API 12-month accelerator (28%)

Marcus / Ben / Neha —

Approved. I agree this is a strategic account and the economics look reasonable as a time-limited accelerator to secure the PO and reference. Approve the 28% accelerator credit for 12 months conditional on:

1) Legal signs off on the SOW (pricing appendix + overage clause).
2) Finance confirms monthly invoicing cadence and AR terms (no unusual net terms extension).
3) AM/CS to schedule a 30/60/90 operational check-in and ensure we have token-level telemetry shared with the customer.

Marcus — proceed to Legal and Finance; copy me on the final SOW circulation. Good work moving this through.

—Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations & Strategy
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 650-555-0124
